title: Toasted Noodle Zenzai
description: A warm, comforting Japanese dessert featuring toasted noodles in a sweet red bean sauce. Perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan.
Add the sugar and stir until dissolved.
Add the red bean paste and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the noodles in a dry pan over medium heat until lightly browned.
Add the toasted noodles to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve warm.
